title: Labor and Human Resources, B.A. -- University Park Track (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: University Park & World Campus track (of two; the other, Commonwealth Campuses, has a similar structure and a slightly lower total). Entrance to major requires a 2.00 GPA and third-semester classification, not modeled directly. Extended lhr_catalog.json (built for Organizational Leadership B.A. earlier this batch) with LHR 100/136Y/201/304/305, all with no enforced prereqs. Bulletin explicitly states 'LHR 304, LHR 305, and LHR 312 may be taken in any order' -- confirmed no artificial sequencing constraint needed. The 'AFAM/LHR/WMNST 136Y or HIST 458Y' pool item was modeled as the literal LHR 136Y pick since it's already cataloged from this same build. 'LA 283' (the same unconfirmed code hit throughout recent Liberal Arts builds) replaced with a generic slot. This plan's computed 8-semester total (126cr) matches the bulletin's own stated total exactly. RE-VERIFIED against the live bulletin (2026-08): found and fixed 3 real bugs. (1) LHR 312 (Research Methods) is one of six explicitly Prescribed courses (the plan's own notes already quoted the bulletin's 'LHR 304, LHR 305, and LHR 312 may be taken in any order' sentence) but was never actually added anywhere in this plan -- entirely missing. Fixed by adding it to Semester 4. (2) The live Suggested Academic Plan places 'PSYCH 281 or LHR 202' in Fall Year 2 (this plan's Semester 3) and 'Supporting Course' in Spring Year 2 (Semester 4) -- this plan had them swapped (PSYCH 281/LHR 202 in Semester 4, an extra generic Gen Ed placeholder in place of Supporting Course in Semester 3) -- corrected the placement of both, credit-neutral. (3) 'Supporting Course' (2 occurrences) had no enumerated list; the live page publishes an exact one for its non-LHR-400-level half: ACCTG 211, AFAM 100N/110N, BA 243/304, BLAW 243, CAS 203/352, ECON 102/104/315/342, HIST 155, MGMT 100/301/321, SOC 103/110/119N, or any OLEAD course (also allows 400-level AFAM/CAS/ECON/HIST/LTNST/MGMT/PHIL/PSYCH/SPAN/SOC/WMNST, an open-ended clause not modeled here) -- enumerated using the specific list (ECON 102/104 omitted since they're already used by this plan's own Entrance-to-Major Economics pick) plus 5 representative OLEAD courses; added ACCTG/AFAM/BA/BLAW/HIST/MGMT/SOC/OLEAD to departments. 'LHR 4XX Course' (2 occurrences) also got a 'match' pattern excluding LHR 494/494H/495/496/497/499 (independent study/special topics), matching the live page's own 'maximum 3 credits from LHR 495 or 496' framing and the same convention CMPSC uses for its own 400-level electives. RE-VERIFIED AGAIN (2026-09-18) via a fresh bulletin_scraper.py fetch of the live page, diffed line-by-line against this file's actual semester structure (the prior 'RE-VERIFIED' pass above never captured its diff): the earlier pass's claims (1)-(3) all check out against the current live page (LHR 312 in Semester 4, PSYCH 281/LHR 202 in Semester 3, Supporting Course in Semester 4, all correctly placed) -- but the same pass introduced two real, previously-uncaught regressions, both now fixed. (a) Semester 1/2's GEN ED domain tags were swapped: this file had 'GEN ED (GQ)' + a bare untagged 'GEN ED' in Semester 1 and 'GEN ED (GN)' in Semester 2, but the live Suggested Academic Plan's Fall Year 1 row is General Education Course (GN) + First-Year Seminar (GH), and its Spring Year 1 row carries the (GQ) course instead -- this exact GN/GH-in-Sem1, GQ-in-Sem2 arrangement is confirmed unchanged from LHR-2022/2023/2024/2025.json, so 2026 alone had drifted. Fixed by restoring GEN ED (GN) + First-Year Seminar (GH) to Semester 1 and GEN ED (GQ) to Semester 2. (b) LHR 305 had been moved to Semester 6 (paired with LHR 4XX and two B.A. Fields slots) while Semester 5 kept only LHR 304; the live Suggested Academic Plan's Fall Year 3 row (this plan's Semester 5) pairs LHR 304 and LHR 305 together with one B.A. Fields slot, and Spring Year 3 (Semester 6) carries two B.A. Fields slots instead -- again matching LHR-2025.json's own (correct) Semester 5/6 split exactly. Fixed by moving LHR 305 back to Semester 5 (swapped for one Elective) and giving Semester 6 an Elective back in its place. Both fixes are credit-neutral (16.5cr in Semester 1, 16cr in Semester 2, 15cr in Semesters 5 and 6, all unchanged; plan's 126cr total unchanged). The plan's longstanding +3cr gap versus the live page's own printed 123cr subtotal sum is NOT a bug: it's the pre-existing, deliberately documented ECON 14/102/104 Entrance-to-Major placeholder (present since LHR-2022.json, predates and is unrelated to the Suggested Academic Plan table) stacked on top of the live total, the same precedent LHR-2025.json already set for LA 83/LA 283. Confirmed via `python3 -c "...build_full_plan..."`: 0 warnings, goal met.
